# Clément BOBIN — Portfolio

> Fullstack developer portfolio. Clément BOBIN is a French fullstack developer (currently alternant at ACTEMIUM Dijon) with skills spanning frontend, backend, DevOps, and mobile development. This site showcases his projects, contributions, tech watch, and experiments.

## Pages

- [Home](https://portfolio-clement.vercel.app/en): Introduction, skills overview, personal projects, and career timeline.
- [Contributions](https://portfolio-clement.vercel.app/en/contributions): Private work, client projects, and open-source contributions that cannot be fully shown publicly.
- [Lab](https://portfolio-clement.vercel.app/en/lab): Interactive experiments and side projects.
- [Veille](https://portfolio-clement.vercel.app/en/veille): Technology watch — curated articles and resources Clément follows.

## About

Clément BOBIN is a future fullstack developer who enjoys analyzing problems, designing appropriate architectures, and building robust solutions — from API to UI, including deployment and automation.

**Frontend:** React, TypeScript, ASP.NET
**Backend:** Node.js, Python, PHP, .NET
**Databases:** MongoDB, SQL, Neon, Prisma
**Mobile:** Kotlin
**Tools:** Docker, Linux, Nix, JetBrains IDEs, Azure
**Practices:** Agile/Scrum, TDD, Code Review, CI/CD
